Digital marketing

Digital marketing campaigns.

Coordinate search, social, advertising, email and landing pages around the customers you want to reach.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Build a channel plan

A review of your market, website and current campaigns helps decide which mix of organic and paid channels deserves the budget.

Connect campaigns to the website

Landing pages, content and email follow-up support Google or Meta campaigns. Conversion tracking is part of the setup.

Review the mix

Compare the enquiries and sales each channel contributes. Reallocate effort based on what the numbers show and agree on the next tests.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Launch — basic SEO, two social channels, two content pieces a month and a quarterly review call.
  • Grow — full SEO, three social channels, one ad platform, four monthly content pieces, email and a quarterly landing page.
  • Scale — multi-market SEO, Google and Meta campaign management, tailored content and fortnightly review calls.
Questions

Before you start.

How long is the initial engagement?

The stated starting term is three months for setup and testing. It then continues monthly.

Can our internal marketing lead stay involved?

Yes. Scope the tasks retained in-house and the specialist tasks assigned to Cloud Haven, with a shared performance report.

Who owns the campaign assets?

The client retains the accounts and content. The team works with delegated access, and platform spend is billed separately from the agency fee.
